messages.text:
"Create a 2D anime-style fighting RPG game with a side-view camera.

GAME FEATURES:

- A character selection screen with 3 unique playable anime characters.
- Beautiful anime-inspired character designs.
- Single-player mode against AI-controlled enemies.
- Real-time combat combining melee attacks and ranged attacks.
- Each character has 3 unique special abilities.
- Mobile-friendly controls with a virtual joystick and attack buttons.
- Smooth idle, walking, running, jumping and attack animations.
- Enemy health bars and player health bars.
- A dark fantasy anime atmosphere.
- A main menu with Play, Character Selection and Settings.
- A playable first level with enemies and a final boss.
- Basic RPG progression and rewards.

IMPORTANT:
Make the game fully playable, not just a visual mockup.
Use simple optimized graphics and smooth performance on Android phones.
Start by building the first playable level.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
